# Failure Injection Catalog v0.1
- provider returns future timestamp
- provider repeats same quote 1000 times
- two trusted providers conflict sharply
- lineup feed disappears before kickoff
- queue delayed beyond freshness SLA
- feature worker crashes mid-run
- model service times out
- duplicate execution event delivered
- database primary fails over
- config drift appears during canary
- cost throttle activates during live slate
- settlement provider delays result
- model candidate improves aggregate score but fails one critical competition slice

Expected behavior must be declared before the experiment.
